an7.37:1.1: XXXVI. Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānena pi. Katamehi sattahi? Piyo hoti manāpo ca, garu ca, bhāvanīyo ca, vattā ca, vacanakkhamo ca, gambhīrañ ca kathaṃ kattā hoti, no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti. Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānena pī ti.
an7.37:2.1: Piyo ca garu bhāvanīyo vattā ca vacanakkhamo gambhīrañ ca kathaṃ kattā no c' aṭṭhāne niyojaye:
an7.37:3.1: yasmiṃ etāni ṭhānāni saṃvijjanti 'dha puggale, so mitto mittakāmena atthakāmānukampako api nāsiyamānena bhajitabbo tathāvidho ti.
